articles.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado presents Trump with her Nobel Peace Prize
articles.mainIdea: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado presents Trump with her Nobel Peace Prize
articles.summary: CBS News Videos: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado presents Trump with her Nobel Peace Prize. Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado met with President Trump on Thursday at the White House. She presented Mr. Trump with her Nobel Peace Prize medal, which was seen as a peace offering to win his support. The president has repeatedly said he should have been awarded the medal. Nancy Cordes reports.
